capabilities: generate list outlines with wikilinks to each heading
generate table outlines with hierarchical numbering, status tags, and word counts
configure source notes, output suffixes, and maximum heading depth
auto-regenerate outlines when source notes are saved
pick up the first tag under each heading as its status
disambiguation: Not an interactive outliner; it generates separate outline files from headings rather than an editable outline pane.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README's Screenshots section is empty and links/images were stripped.
motivation: The author notes that writers work non-linearly and that tracking each section's status becomes unmanageable as a manuscript grows, so they need an entry point every time they sit down to write.
problem: Obsidian's outline view doesn't show section status or word counts, and writers need a fixed entry point to see where a growing manuscript stands.

relations.evidence: Example status tags (pair with Colored Tags Wrangler for visual distinction)

summary: Outline generator that creates list and table outline files from a note's headings, showing each section's status tag and word count.
